name: UPS sell path burns the pair's reserve
summary: UPS burns the sold amount, less the fee, straight from its PancakeSwap USDT pair and calls sync() before a non-whitelisted sale reaches the pair. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought nearly all UPS out to a whitelisted recipient (plain buys revert), then sold UPS so the burn emptied the pair's UPS reserve and the swap paid out the pair's USDT.
notes: Non-upgradeable token. The deployer stays whitelisted from the constructor, so the later whitelist grant to the buy recipient 0x4ef09b34 and the node-list writes were not needed.

Loss is the pair's USDT depletion. The UPS bought out of the pair was paid for with the attacker's flash-loaned USDT in the same transaction and has no market price after the drain, so it is not counted.
